title: Passage to Chult
epigraph: Azlund put them under a zone of truth in the House of Healing before he would say the words Death Curse, then paid them fifty gold and a map of Chult to go find its source. On the crossing they traced a missing wheel of cheese to a Zhentarim stowaway, which was enough to make the passenger calling himself Corwin admit he was Artus Cimber and wore the Ring of Winter. He teleported them off the deck when the pirates boarded, and they came down in the Harbor Ward of Port Nyanzaru without him. The weeks since have gone to rented dinosaurs and bought canoes while they collect the names of anyone who might know where the Soulmonger is.

title: Down the Soshenstar to the Silent City
epigraph: They went down the Soshenstar by canoe and reached Camp Vengeance in time to watch it turn on itself, a creeper in a cave doing the choosing for the men who ran the place. The goblin camp they came north to raid was launched over the jungle on a cut vine before they could sack it, and all they carried off was the amulet from the queen's body in the wreckage. Their guide resigned in Port Nyanzaru, and most of what followed was done for other people, chiefly taking the forge at Hrakhamar back for a dwarf outpost that had asked them nicely. They put down the fire the firenewts raised on Mount Todra and came back to Fort Beluarian with a borrowed gauntlet and a bill for forty percent of everything else.
